title: Live 3D with Cycles' light baked onto the model (generated cover): the reference, the model in Cycles, and live with the baked light
notes: part: The cover sits on the ridge and looks heavy: the round ring wraps it and the ridge rolls under its edge; the ring is thinner than the reference's.
part: The ridge is one unbroken line from under the cover to the tail: one roll all the way, lit along its top; its highlight fades under the words.
ok: The twist and the sheet over the buttons read clearly.
part: The words are clean: no line crosses the title and the glass behind them is darker; a reflection still touches the title's end and runs behind the artist's.
part: The glass shines: the light now falls where the studio puts it (baked in Cycles): tops lit, the sheet's crest bright, deeper low down; clear, warm rims; still less brilliant than the reference.
